explanation: The pthread_mutexattr_init function initializes a pthread_mutexattr_t structure with default mutex attributes. It is used to set up an object that allows customization of mutex properties, such as process-sharing behavior, before creating a mutex. This ensures that mutexes can be configured appropriately for thread synchronization in multi-threaded or multi-process environments, promoting safe access to shared resources.
